newsitem.title: CHINA: China says Germany's Kinkel welcome to visit.
newsitem.headline: China says Germany's Kinkel welcome to visit.

text.p: China's Foreign Minister Qian Qichen has told German counterpart Klaus Kinkel that he is welcome to visit China, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
Kinkel's visit, initially scheduled for July, was postponed by Beijing in June after the German parliament passed a resolution criticising Beijing's policy on Tibet.

"The Chinese side expressed welcome to German President Roman Herzog to visit China...and welcomed Foreign Minister Kinkel to visit China beforehand," Xinhua said, without giving further details on the possible timing of the trips.
Qian and Kinkel, meeting at the United Nations in New York, agreed to make every effort to expand Sino-German relations, Xinhua said.
Although differences existed between the two sides on human rights, these should be ironed out through dialogue rather than confrontation, it said.
